name: VO2 6x2 moderate 44
description: Six 2 min reps at 11.5 km/h level 1 with 2 min jog recoveries: short, fast, high oxygen uptake. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: VO2 2 min
steps.notes: RPE 8-9: hard but controlled; the last rep matches the first.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
